title: Clovis
creator: CrossFit
description: Run 10 miles and complete 150 burpee pull-ups, partitioned however you like. Honours U.S. Army 2nd Lt. Clovis T. Ray, killed by an IED in Kunar Province, Afghanistan, in 2012. A two-hour undertaking; halve both numbers for a still-serious session.
